text:
riley: Morning riddle 0 — did anyone swap my mug for one labeled "Probably Not Yours"?
jamie: guilty? maybe. It had a tiny dinosaur sticker and I couldn't resist.
zara: If it's the mug with the purple handle, that's mine. But the dinosaur mug is delightful.
ben: GIF: <link_to_mug-mystery.gif> caption: "The Mug That Could"
riley: It had a note inside: "If you can read this, you're borrowing coffee." Cute but now I feel obligated.
jamie: Also side note: I found a kazoo in the plant pot. Who's starting spontaneous lunchtime kazoo sessions?
zara: Not me. I only bring applause. But tiny instruments = good morale.
ben: poll: :one: keep the kazoo for lunchtime jams / :two: return to the wild (aka the supply closet)
jamie: :one: keep. Will schedule 12:30 kazoo interlude for 3 songs.
snack-bot: Snack inventory: chocolate chip cookies low, kazoo count unaffected. (automated)
riley: Also I'll leave a sticky note on the mystery-mug: "Borrowed by riley until further notice. May contain crumbs."
zara: If anyone wants to claim it, shout in thread. Otherwise adoption ceremony at 4pm with kazoo fanfare.
jamie: I'll bring a tiny banner and a safety briefing for kazoo etiquette (no solos during deep focus hours).
ben: GIF: <link_to_kazoo_party.gif> caption: "When you hit the chorus in standup"
riley: Outcome: mug temporarily claimed, kazoo stays, cookies to be reordered by Snack Ops. Peace and small musical instruments. Thread closed unless the mug relocates or the kazoo forms a union.
